$comment: Generated from OutTurn in ../agents/dist/out/types.d.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. One line of a session's turns.jsonl in its out directory.
title: OutTurn

CostUsd.description: A dollar figure and where it came from.

basis.description: `reported`: what the harness (Claude Code, pi) or the gateway (OpenRouter) said it cost; `estimated`: the tokens at list prices, which leave out discounts and long-context rates.

source.description: Who reported it (`claude-code`, `pi`, `openrouter`, `fake`), or the prices it was estimated at (`models.dev 2026-11-05`, a `REEVAL_PRICES` file); several, joined with `, `, in a sum.

OutTurn.description: One line of `turns.jsonl`: a turn's result, less its transcript, raw parts and steps.

agentMs.description: The turn's agent time, recorded in place of the wall clock around `send`; only a scripted harness sets it.

cost.description: What the harness said the turn cost, when it says.

model.description: The model the harness says served the turn; null when it reports none.

providerStop.description: When the model provider, not the agent, ended the turn: the run is then an infra error.

reasoningMs.description: Milliseconds the agent spent reasoning in the turn, from the reasoning blocks it streamed; null when the harness can't time its reasoning, and absent for a scripted harness, whose reasoning events carry their own durations.

rejectedKey.description: The turn's error, naming the variable, when the model API rejected the harness's credential: the run is then an infra error, not the agent's failure.

text.description: The agent's final message for the turn.

turn.description: The turn's index in the session, from 0.

unreported.description: Event types the harness can't report, so their absence from `transcript` proves nothing.

usage.description: Tokens the turn used, when the harness reports them.

ProviderStop.description: A turn the model provider stopped, with the message to fail the turn's run with.

TokenUsage.description: The tokens one turn used, as its harness reported them. `input` excludes cache reads and writes (so the prompt was `input + cacheRead + cacheWrite`); `reasoning` is part of `output`.

WebEventType.description: The transcript events a harness may be unable to report.
